facts.statement: Lacuna Station rations heat because its damaged reactor cannot safely support every compartment at once.
The refugee ship carries eighty-three people, including thirty-one children; four passengers are in medical cold-sleep and the youngest is two.
Nera diverted twelve minutes of station heat to thaw the refugee ship's catalyst valves and falsified the automatic refusal.
The diversion delayed heat for the old habitation ring and its 806 residents by twelve minutes.
The refugee ship restarted its drive and departed before the patrol arrived.
